pages.text: Drop an activated scroll into the empty crucible. Before officially starting, it is necessary to systematically learn the crucible's HUD.

pages.title: Reading the HUD
pages.text: The left bar shows catalyst, input, essence discovery progress, and output. The leftmost bar reports scroll durability and stability.$(br2)In the center, a colored border marks the selected essence slot, and unlocked slots reveal their target essence. Hold Shift and scroll the mouse wheel to select another slot.

pages.title: Dial and Warnings
pages.text: The upper-right dial shows current polarity with its outer pointer. Two inner pointers mark the recipe's allowed range, and the hourglass counts down to expiration.$(br2)A lower-right hint explains what is missing whenever the reaction cannot proceed.

pages.title: Scroll Alchemy HUD
pages.text: Use the arrows at the lower-right of the image to inspect each annotated region of the HUD.

pages.title: Essence Wheel
pages.text: Hold a storage box while looking at the crucible. Scroll to select an essence; right-click to insert one into the selected slot. Hold Alt to expand the wheel and check how that essence relates to all the others.

pages.title: Essence Wheel Relations
pages.text: With the wheel expanded, border colors show how the selected essence relates to each candidate.
